1.w: For the one directing. On stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph. A Song. In Judah God is known, in Israel His name [is] great.

2.w: And His tent is in Salem, and his dwelling place in Zion.

3.w: There he has shattered the arrows of the bow—the shield and sword and weapon of war. Selah

4.w: luminous are You and majestic, from the mountains of prey.

5.w: They became plunder, the mighty of heart; they have slept their sleep, and the men of might could not find any of their hands.

6.w: At Your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the rider and horse are lain asleep.

7.w: You are to be feared—You! And who can stand before Your face at the time of Your anger?

8.w: From the heavens You have sounded the judgment; the earth has feared and has been still,

9.w: at the rising of God to the judgment, to bring salvation [to] all the lowly ones of the earth. Selah

10.w: for the wrath of man shall praise You; with the remainder of wrath You gird Yourself.

11.w: Make vows to YHWH your⁺ God, and fulfill [them]; let all around Him bring tribute to the Fearsome One.

12.w: He takes away the spirit of princes; He is feared by the kings of the earth.
